headline: Stock-market divide signals potential for big surge or deep plunge
detail: This headline suggests the market is at a critical juncture, with potential for extreme moves in either direction. For your tech/chip heavy, margin-leveraged portfolio, this means amplified gains or losses.
rec: Be extra vigilant with your leveraged positions (SOXL, SPAL) and ensure stops are in place and respected.
